title: The common-stage projection composition equation on finite models
statement:
Fix finite-field datum $D$, coefficient datum $C$, and $H:\mathrm{SixFunctorCommonStages}(D,C)$ [def-sf-operation-stages]. Write $S=H.\mathrm{commonStage}$, $T_X=H.\mathrm{commonStageTensor}(X)$, $\pi_{f,c}(K,L)$ for the specified compact-support projection [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates], and $\iota_{E,X}$ for the common-stage inclusion [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Fix one finite coefficient field $E$ and suppose its rational stage satisfies CompactSupportProjectionCoherence on every second input [def-sf-projection-comparison-equations]. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be separated, locally of finite type and quasi-compact, with compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_{fg}$ of $f,g,fg$. For $K_E\in\mathrm{Stage}_E(X)$ and $L_E\in\mathrm{Stage}_E(Z)$, set $K=\iota_{E,X}K_E$ and $L=\iota_{E,Z}L_E$. Write $m$ for the hom component of $S.\mathrm{composition}_{f,g,c_f,c_g,c_{fg}}$ and $r$ for the hom component of $S.\mathrm{pullComposition}_{f,g}$. Then
$$T_Z(m_K,1_L);\pi_{g,c_g}(S_{f,c_f}K,L);S_{g,c_g}(\pi_{f,c_f}(K,S.\mathrm{pull}_gL))=\pi_{fg,c_{fg}}(K,L);m_{T_X(K,S.\mathrm{pull}_{fg}L)};S_{g,c_g}S_{f,c_f}(T_X(1_K,r_L)).$$
Here $S_{f,c}=S.\mathrm{support}(f,c)$, and semicolon denotes composition in displayed order. This asserts only this binary equation on the included models, with no refinement, pentagon or proper conclusion.

proof.text: Obtain one tensor natural isomorphism for each space and its single-arrow projection compatibility square from lem-sf-common-projection-tensor-compatibility. Apply the already proved generic ProjectionCoefficientTransport.composition_transfer from RationalProjectionComparisonEquations to H.commonStageComparison E, this tensorator, and these squares. That calculation uses tensor and projection naturality, support-compositor preservation and pullComposition preservation, and cancels the source comparison isomorphism. Supply hH.composition at the two original rational models. The result is exactly the required composition equation on their included common-stage models; no equation is reflected through inclusion. The generic calculation is reused via a proof-only import all, without using compactSupportProjectionCoherence_rational or rationalProjectionTensorCompatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem commonProjectionComposition_onStage
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    (H : SixFunctorCommonStages D C)
    (E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar)
    (hH : CompactSupportProjectionCoherence (H.coefficientStages E₀).rational
      (H.coefficientStages E₀).rationalTensor (H.coefficientStages E₀).rationalExchange
      (fun _ _ ↦ True))
    {X Y Z : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    [IsSeparated g.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType g.hom.left] [QuasiCompact g.hom.left]
    (cf : Compactification f.hom.left) (cg : Compactification g.hom.left)
    (cfg : Compactification (f ≫ g).hom.left)
    (K₀ : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage C.l C.Qbar X.obj.left E₀)
    (L₀ : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage C.l C.Qbar Z.obj.left E₀) :
    let K := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := X.obj.left) E₀).obj K₀;
    let L := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Z.obj.left) E₀).obj L₀;
      ((H.commonStageTensor Z).map ((H.commonStage.composition f g cf cg cfg).hom.app K)).app L ≫
          compactSupportProjectionComponent H.commonStageExchange g cg
            ((H.commonStage.support f cf).obj K) L ≫
          (H.commonStage.support g cg).map
            (compactSupportProjectionComponent H.commonStageExchange f cf K
              ((H.commonStage.pull g).obj L)) =
        compactSupportProjectionComponent H.commonStageExchange (f ≫ g) cfg K L ≫
          (H.commonStage.composition f g cf cg cfg).hom.app
            (((H.commonStageTensor X).obj K).obj ((H.commonStage.pull (f ≫ g)).obj L)) ≫
          (H.commonStage.support g cg).map ((H.commonStage.support f cf).map
            (((H.commonStageTensor X).obj K).map
              ((H.commonStage.pullComposition f g).hom.app L)))
